关键是找准人工智能在教学流程中的合理位置: The key is to find the right place for artificial intelligence in the teaching process
倪闽景：人工智能能够快速给出答案，更需要教师引导学生从真实观察出发，带着自己的思: Ni Minjing: Artificial intelligence can quickly provide answers, which makes it all the more important for teachers to guide students to start from real observations, pose questions with their own thinking, scrutinize answers, and verify them firsthand, turning curiosity into a lasting drive for inquiry
在辨析环节，可以先让学生作出猜想，再借助人工智能比较不同方案，讨论其中的矛盾与不: In the analysis stage, students can first make conjectures, then use artificial intelligence to compare different approaches and discuss the contradictions and shortcomings among them
面对人工智能可能出现的错误，教师应引导学生追问依据、检验推理，在辨别和求证中形成: In the face of possible errors from artificial intelligence, teachers should guide students to question the evidence and check the reasoning, forming their own judgments through discrimination and verification
记者：如何让乡村和薄弱学校也能用好人工智能教育资源: Reporter: How can rural and under-resourced schools also make good use of artificial intelligence education resources
柳玲玲：在乡村和薄弱学校调研时，我感到，用人工智能辅助教学，既有接入的门槛，也有: Liu Lingling: In my research at rural and under-resourced schools, I have found that using artificial intelligence to assist teaching involves both barriers to access and difficulties in use and maintenance
张志勇：人工智能赋能教育，应着力缩小区域、城乡、校际差距，防止产生新的数字鸿沟: Zhang Zhiyong: In empowering education with artificial intelligence, efforts should focus on narrowing gaps among regions, between urban and rural areas, and among schools, and preventing the emergence of new digital divides
建议统筹推进教育数智化基础设施建设，将算力纳入公共教育基础设施建设，加强公共资源: It is suggested to coordinate the development of educational digital and intelligent infrastructure, incorporate computing power into public education infrastructure construction, strengthen the supply of public resources, and ensure that schools in under-resourced areas receive sustained and appropriate support
应健全人工智能产品和服务审查机制，加强算法、内容和伦理审查，将伦理和教育风险评估: A review mechanism for artificial intelligence products and services should be improved, with stronger review of algorithms, content, and ethics, moving ethical and educational risk assessment forward to the algorithm design stage
保护学生隐私，坚持非必要不采集学生相关数据，完善使用规则，引导学生合理使用人工智: Student privacy should be protected; student-related data should not be collected unless necessary; usage rules should be improved to guide students in using artificial intelligence sensibly
人工智能可以辅助学习，但不能用分析结果来定义学生: Artificial intelligence can assist learning, but students must not be defined by its analysis results
